# Developer Portal and API Documentation

**Period:** 2020–2022
**Role:** Outreach Technical Writer → API Technical Writer II
**Organization:** Technical Content Management → Integrations

## Context

The company's public-facing developer documentation portal needed dedicated editorial governance, content strategy, and sprint-based documentation workflows. There was no structured intake process, no release notes cadence, and API guides were inconsistent in quality and coverage.

## Challenge

Establish the developer portal as a well-managed documentation product with consistent quality, clear processes for content contribution, and measurable engagement — while growing from an individual contributor into an API documentation lead managing a multi-writer team.

## Approach

- Led bi-weekly sprint planning meetings with technical writers. Implemented quarterly epics to group and track work for specific APIs.
- Built a Jira dashboard to provide visibility into ticket volume and team efforts.
- Wrote Jira management documentation and updated the intake and triage process to standardize how documentation requests were handled.
- Edited, rewrote, and published API integration guides across multiple product areas:
  - OAuth implementation guides (2-legged and 3-legged flows)
  - Job posting API integration guides
  - Getting started documentation
  - Disposition data API documentation
- Published release notes for internal stakeholders on a regular cadence.
- Co-wrote process documentation for tech writer contribution workflows and access request management, enabling a major platform migration by the launch date.
- Developed an interim solution for processing developer portal access requests, then escalated the need for automation and worked with engineering to adopt a scalable solution.
- Led an internal knowledge-sharing platform engagement campaign: evangelized the platform to tech guilds, seeded 58 Q&As on cloud migration topics, set up Slack integrations, and created enablement materials that drove a published endorsement from the documentation community.

## Outcomes

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Developer portal unique page views | 131,881 (6-month period) |
| Jira tickets resolved | 57 |
| Partner accounts processed | 500+ |
| API integration guides published | 6+ |
| Knowledge platform search increase | 59% |
| Knowledge platform question increase | 53% |
| Knowledge platform answer increase | 51% |
| Q&As seeded for adoption | 58 |

## Live Work

Documentation I authored and actively maintain:

- [Get Started](https://docs.indeed.com/getstarted/) — developer onboarding and orientation
- [Simulated GraphQL Environment](https://docs.indeed.com/getstarted/simulated-graphql-environment/) — sandbox tooling guide for API partners
- [Hiring Lab API](https://docs.indeed.com/hiring-lab-api/) — public API reference documentation
- [Release Notes](https://docs.indeed.com/release-notes/) — ongoing changelog; also the output of the release notes automation pipeline built in 2025 (see [AI-Enhanced Documentation Innovation](/portfolio/05-ai-documentation-innovation))
